name: Brick with Sparse Top-Level
aliases: Brick-based Sparse Voxel Lookup with Open-Addressing Hash > Two-Level Sparse Voxel Grid Layout > Brick with Sparse Top-Level
Sparse Voxel Brick Storage with Palette Compression
definition: A voxel data structure using 8×8×8 voxel bricks compressed with an occupancy mask and material palette, organized under a sparse top-level index.
summary: Brick with Sparse Top-Level stores planet-scale voxel data using sparse 8³ bricks and a top-level index, minimizing memory via palette compression while avoiding full sparse tree complexity.
